variants.name: 正統進化
variants.description: 今の形を最も残し、青い光・輪郭・字間を整える。
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand refinement of the supplied existing raster logo.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and identity anchor, the current Japanese game title logo.
Produce ONE polished alternative logo, not a contact sheet, not a website mockup.
Preserve the identity: elegant Japanese Mincho/serif lettering, six exact characters "惑星の放課後", a smaller exact uppercase subtitle "GAIA SENSATION", a graceful tilted planetary orbit and a few restrained stars. Keep it unmistakably an evolution of the reference, not a different brand.
Text must be exact: 惑 / 星 / の / 放 / 課 / 後 in that order. Subtitle G A I A [space] S E N S A T I O N. No additional copy, labels or numbers.
Use a clean solid very dark midnight-navy background, no nebula, no scene, no texture behind the mark. Wide landscape canvas approximately 3:1, logo occupies about 82% width, centered with safe margins. Crisp professional vector-like edges. No noisy rough blue outlines, no chromatic glitches, no unreadable fine subtitle, no excessive sparkle, no watermark. The mark must read as a usable title identity, not an illustration.

Variation direction: Keep the exact existing horizontal silhouette and distinctive sweeping strokes as closely as possible. Refine every contour; balance optical kerning around the smaller の; turn the harsh outer blue glow into a fine cobalt-to-ice-blue rim with a clean ivory-white letter face. Make the elliptical orbit one exceptionally smooth continuous taper, with only two controlled glints. Clean up the subtitle spacing and separate it from the orbit. This is the closest-to-current, flagship polished edition.
